paragraphs.text: Or Azzah, a city of the Philistines.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: He means the army of the Chaldeans, Isa 8:7,8.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: The great fear will take away their natural affection.
paragraphs.label: c
paragraphs.anchor: the fathers shall not look back

paragraphs.text: Their heart will so fail them.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: For the Caphtorims had destroyed in old time the Philistines, and dwelt in their land even to Gaza, De 2:23.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: They who shaved their heads for sorrow and heaviness.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: As the heathen used in their mourning, which the Lord forbade his people to do, De 14:1.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: Meaning, that it is not profitable that the wicked should by any means escape or hinder the Lord when he will take vengeance.
paragraphs.label: h
